purpose: Preserve Shared Mind project reasoning and work state so any AI session can continue without re-explanation.

memory_assertions.value: All clients and sessions observe one canonical project state; only task-specific context views differ.
Agent Loadout was removed because Agent-specific memory partitions recreate knowledge fragmentation.
Core Context is a disposable derived projection and never authoritative truth.
Factual and project state mutates only through a validated kernel Proposal and append-only ledger.
Shared procedural Skill state mutates through a versioned ProductMutationProposal, receipt, audit hash chain, version guard, review, and replay.
